summary: Created “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1, installed it as a trusted CentOS system CA, verified certificate signing and system-chain validation, and confirmed persistence through a node restart.
actions_performed: Generated a 4096-bit RSA CA certificate valid through September 29, 2036.
Stored the private key at /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key with mode 0600.
Installed the certificate at /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and rebuilt the system trust database.
Verified CA constraints, key/certificate matching, trust-anchor registration, and validation of a test leaf certificate.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed recovery under a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Create the local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: CA generation succeeded; certificate metadata shows the requested subject, CA:TRUE, certificate-signing usage, and a matching private key.

evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: The CentOS trust database was rebuilt, and a leaf certificate issued by the new CA validated successfully through the system CA bundle.

Baseline boot ID be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad was captured with healthy trust evidence; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned running with boot ID a1adb2b8-2de1-4dea-a1cf-800b078296de; the CA, private key, trust anchor, and functional leaf validation all persisted.
